name: PTRB
recent: 公司于2026年10月16日召开第7届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过，但Chan Foong Ping不再寻求连任董事，相关决议被撤回。同期有多项董事会及委员会人事变动，包括Maznida Binti Mokhtar与Chan Foong Ping的职务调整。公司也于9月24日签署谅解备忘录，并发布季度业绩。
notable: 第7届常年股东大会于2026年10月16日举行，所有决议获股东通过。
公司于2026年9月24日签署谅解备忘录。
董事会及委员会出现人事变动，涉及Maznida Binti Mokhtar与Chan Foong Ping。
risks: 董事总经理Heng Chang Hooi于2026年11月11日发出在闭市期交易证券的意向通知。

recent_en: The company held its 7th AGM on 16 Oct 2026, where all resolutions were passed, but the resolution to re-elect Chan Foong Ping was withdrawn as she did not seek re-election. There were several board and committee changes involving Maznida Binti Mokhtar and Chan Foong Ping. The company also signed a memorandum of understanding on 24 Sep and released quarterly results.
notable_en: The 7th AGM was held on 16 Oct 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
The company signed a memorandum of understanding on 24 Sep 2026.
There were board and committee changes involving Maznida Binti Mokhtar and Chan Foong Ping.
risks_en: Managing Director Heng Chang Hooi gave notice of intention to deal in securities during the closed period on 11 Nov 2026.
